body.prompt: Create an accessible Modal component using CSS Modules (.module.css). MUST use named export 'export const Modal = ...'. MUST define a TypeScript 'interface' explicitly declaring 'isOpen?: boolean', 'children?: React.ReactNode', and an 'onClose' callback function. MUST use semantic dialog structure. MUST include 'aria-modal={true}', exact 'role="dialog"', and 'aria-labelledby' on the modal container. MUST handle keyboard accessibility including Escape handling and focus management, utilizing 'tabIndex'. MUST NOT use 'any' or inline 'style={{...}}'. MUST include responsive styling.
